CLAIM RELEASED (G04 author draft pass 1 handoff)

Session: `ADB991-claude-20261113-15a6`
Claim: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/60#issuecomment-6848382153
Draft PR: #119 (branch `ADB991:claude/issue-60-15a6` @ `cc8e39c`, base `codex/existence-monograph` @ `17b8f91`)

**Established.** `manuscript/existence/argument-outline.tex` is a draft Section 2. It is not yet included; the include line is proposed patch P1 for F01. It has seven parts:
- the status of the argument: the target is conditional on `ex-joint-input`, and there is no mass-gap claim;
- the reader prerequisites, placing G03 P3 here;
- the context;
- the order of limits;
- a nine-step plan in dependency order, each step pointing to its producing labels;
- a map from steps to sections, which makes the gap between presentation order and dependency order explicit;
- the open interfaces.

Every cross-reference resolves in a full local build (964 pp.). The section adds no mathematics and uses no Lean names. A claim-to-producer ledger is in `results/G04/ledger.md`.

**Uncertain.**
- G04-F1: is $\lambda_G=11C_G/(24\pi^2)$ (C10 annulus) equal to $2b_0$ of the running-coefficient unit? That depends on the Casimir normalization, and the shooting slope $s_G$ is not identified. The outline states this as part of C11-to-G02-running and does not assert it.
- The five historical citations (Wilson 1974, Gross–Wilczek and Politzer 1973, OS 1973, Bałaban 1987) have metadata checked on INSPIRE only; their texts were not read (findings §H).
- Most chapter descriptions rest on read-only subagent summaries. They were checked against labels and theorem types, but not line by line.

**Next.**
1. Apply the G05 notation/order contract (#61) when it lands, for example $\nu$ vs $\mu$ for the character measure and time-first vs time-last coordinates. Then finalize.
2. G03 pass 2: audit findings table H.
3. Independent mathematics/source review of the outline at its final hash. Not by this account.

Released now because finalization waits on G05 and G03.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.
